rgsteinerne.name: Stone Bridge
rgsteinerne.slogan: Sixteen arches that have carried Regensburg over the Danube for 900 years.
rgsteinerne.line: Built in about eleven years, between 1135 and 1146, it is 308.7 metres long and stands on 16 arches.

rgdom.name: Regensburg Cathedral
rgdom.slogan: Gothic lace in stone, with a boys' choir still singing under it.
rgdom.line: Its twin spires, 105 metres high, were only finished between 1859 and 1869, centuries after the nave.

rgwalhalla.name: Walhalla
rgwalhalla.slogan: A Greek temple on a Danube hillside, full of marble heroes.
rgwalhalla.line: Crown Prince Ludwig modelled it on the Parthenon; Leo von Klenze built it from 1830 to 1842, and it now holds about 130 busts.

rgweltenburgabtei.name: Weltenburg Abbey
rgweltenburgabtei.slogan: Baroque gold at the foot of the Danube's narrowest gorge.
rgweltenburgabtei.line: Its brewery dates to 1050, and the Asam brothers built the abbey church between 1716 and 1739.

lstrausnitz.name: Trausnitz Castle
lstrausnitz.slogan: The Wittelsbach hilltop seat that watches over Landshut's rooftops.
lstrausnitz.line: Duke Ludwig I founded it in 1204, and it was the Wittelsbach ducal residence for Lower Bavaria from 1255 to 1503.
